title: Rockefeller Foundation COO transition to Ashvin Dayal
summary: The Foundation announced Ashvin Dayal as its new COO, succeeding Natalye Paquin, who was scheduled to retire August 1, 2026; the current leadership page lists Dayal as Chief Operating Officer.

sources.title: Ashvin Dayal Named COO of The Rockefeller Foundation

data.name: Rockefeller Foundation COO transition
data.description: The Rockefeller Foundation announced on May 14, 2026 that Ashvin Dayal had been named COO and would succeed Natalye Paquin, who would retire August 1, 2026. The Foundation's current leadership page lists Dayal as Chief Operating Officer.

temporal.notes: August 1 is the announced retirement/succession boundary from the Foundation's May 14 release; current leadership confirms Dayal now holds the COO role.

caveats: The event date represents the announced succession boundary, not an independently reconstructed first working day.
